title: JGlistening Japanese Kombu Bisque
description: A cultured and glassy-jelly-like dish featuring kombu without onions or garlic, perfect for adventurous Syrian cuisine.

ingredients.name: 1 tbsp soy sauce (or tamari for gluten-free option)

instructions: Rinse the kombu pieces thoroughly under cold running water.
Place the rinsed kombu in a pot of boiling water and poach until softened, about 20 minutes. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Strain the kombu out of the broth, leaving only the flavorful water behind.
In another pot, bring the remaining broth to a simmer and add soy sauce (and bonito flakes if using).
Reduce the liquid by half to concentrate the flavor, about 10 minutes. Do not let it boil dry.
Serve immediately over steamed rice or noodles as desired.
